description: Minimum retrieval quality for `npm run eval:rag -- --gate` (errors is a maximum). Set a little under the first live run (2026-11-19, text-embedding-3-large + LLM reranker: hit@1 1.00, grounded 0.98, evidence precision 0.85, abstention 0.93) to absorb LLM variance. Raise a bound when a change measurably improves it; never lower one to make a change pass.
